text:
maya (support): Escalating FluxWare onboarding - customer can't finish SSO and Dedicated provisioning hit a 403. Renewal in ~30 days, flagging as high risk if we don't unblock today.
liam (cs): Copy. What exactly is failing? any logs/screenshots?
maya (support): They updated ACS URL in their IdP. Browser shows `Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) mismatch` when hitting our SSO callback. Separately our /v1/provision call returned 403. Screenshot uploaded.
liam (cs): Assigning @sara to own comms and @raj to triage the 403. I'll loop sales if this becomes a renewal risk.
sara (cs): On it. I'll send a quick "we're investigating" note to Mark and set an ETA.
raj (eng): Quick look: tenant routing table for tenant `fluxware` didn't bind after their key rotation. Provisioner rejects because tenant_id missing in routing -> 403. Kicking off reseed. Command: `/bin/reseed-tenant --tenant fluxware --region=us-west2`
deploy-bot: reseed job started (job-id: rs-4982) for tenant fluxware
maya (support): After reseed, provision endpoint returned 200 for new requests; customer briefly saw 403 for ~20s then success.
liam (cs): Nice. Sara, prepare customer-facing summary: root cause (IdP ACS mismatch + transient routing/provisioning issue), steps we took, and monitoring window. Suggest offering a small concession if needed.
sara (cs): Draft -> "Hi Mark — we found two issues: your IdP's ACS URL didn't match tenant config (we synced it), and a transient routing error caused provisioning to fail; we reseeded your tenant and verified provisioning is working. Please retry SSO and confirm. We'll monitor for 24 hours and can offer a 2-week trial extension if helpful." Sending now.
anna (sales): FYI FluxWare is mid-upsell cadence; onboarding completion is critical for ACV. Keep me posted.
raj (eng): I'll tail provisioner logs and alert if errors recur: `tail -f /var/log/provisioner/fluxware.log | grep ERROR` - monitoring for 2 hours.
maya (support): Customer reply: "SSO and onboarding completed. Thanks!" (received ~20m after fix)
sara (cs): Updated CRM: onboarding status -> "Completed", renewal risk -> "Cleared". Concession offered but declined.
liam (cs): Closing escalation. Summary of actions: Sara - CRM + final comms, Raj - 2h monitoring, Maya - watch for support alerts, Liam - notify renewal team and sales. Great work team :tada:
